bio.text: Austin Scott represents Georgia's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House and, according to his office, is in his eighth term.
He serves on the Intelligence, Armed Services, Agriculture and Rules committees and is Vice Chairman of the House Agriculture Committee.
He graduated from the University of Georgia with a B.B.A. in Risk Management and Insurance, owned an insurance brokerage for nearly twenty years, and lives in Tifton.
